targeted_distance: Euclidean distance after estate pre-window standardisation, population standard deviation; zero-variance features excluded
weighted_sensitivity: Fixed sum of treatment and control pre-window Standard joins per pair
revenue_counterfactual: Treatment pre-period revenue multiplied by control post/pre revenue ratio; differences are estimates for the observed historical period
incumbent_definition: Current Standard members with opening exposure whose original join month predates the event, including unknown-date opening legacy members
